data.description:
## Problem

Discovered-from CG-0MUTTXRWZ009NUB9 (Add a Favicon).

The app declares an SVG favicon (`<link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="favicon.svg" />`), which modern browsers honour. However browsers and tooling still request `/favicon.ico` unconditionally as a fallback (observed: `GET /favicon.ico 404` on the dev server). On a cold load with no declared icon, or in tools that only look for `.ico`, this produces a 404 and a generic tab icon.

## Desired change

Generate and serve a real `/favicon.ico` from the tracked tableau emblem (`public/favicon.svg`) alongside the existing PNG variants, so the fallback request resolves.

- Extend `scripts/generate-app-icons.ts` with an `.ico` target (multi-resolution 16/32/48 px, produced with `sharp`'s `toFormat('ico')` if available, or an ICO container built from the PNG buffers) written to `public/favicon.ico`.
- Keep the SVG as the primary `rel="icon"`; add a defensive `<link rel="icon" href="favicon.ico" sizes="any" />` after it.
- Extend `tests/scripts/generate-app-icons.test.ts` to assert the `.ico` artefact exists, has the ICO signature, and contains at least one image; extend the build-output test to assert `favicon.ico` is present in `dist/`.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. `npm run generate:icons` produces `public/favicon.ico` from the emblem, and the file is committed.
2. `index.html` references `favicon.ico` as a fallback icon link.
3. Tests assert the `.ico` is generated (signature + non-empty) and present in the production build output.
4. Full suite passes.

## Notes

Low priority — the SVG favicon works in modern browsers; this is robustness for legacy/tooling fallback requests. Out of scope of the original epic's ACs (which only required a favicon link), recorded as discovered work.
data.title: Serve a real /favicon.ico fallback so browsers/tools stop 404ing
